notes.title: Super Cat Simulator Announcement Trailer is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=eF3J_oci7GE;full][/previewyoutube]

We are happy to announce that our pre-alpha trailer is now live!

We have now opened our discord channel, so please join us! 

[url=https://discord.gg/2mqkWQN9]https://discord.gg/2mqkWQN9[/url]

Help support the development of Super Cat Simulator and get exclusive rewards! 

The link to our Kickstarter is in our Discord and on our official website: [url=https://supercatsimulator.com/]https://supercatsimulator.com/[/url]

Thank you for all your support and we look forward to seeing you in the Discord.
